name: educore
description: EduCore (familia PeopleCore): plataforma de gestión académica y administrativa para instituciones educativas.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @educore/api" "npm run dev -w @educore/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @educore/shared && npm run build -w @educore/api && npm run build -w @educore/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @educore/api && npm run test -w @educore/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @educore/shared && npm run typecheck -w @educore/api && npm run typecheck -w @educore/web
